name: matchlens
description: Matchlens: multi-agent live match intelligence (FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend)

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.dev:backend:offline: cd backend && MATCHLENS_LLM=offline uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
